name: coverage-tools
description: Run tests with coverage and show the results in VS Code's native coverage view.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Coverage Tools only reads coverage reports; it does not run any command.

enumDescriptions: One test project at a time. The lightest on the machine, and the right choice on a computer with few processor cores or little memory.

Several test projects at the same time. Faster, but every extra run takes its own share of processor and memory. How many run at once is limited to what this machine has room for; .NET projects still run one after another.
coverageTools.run.mode.markdownDescription: Whether test projects run in sequence or in parallel. Sequence is the default so that coverage runs do not take over the machine's processor and memory. In parallel, the number of runs at a time follows `#coverageTools.run.maxParallel#`.

coverageTools.run.maxParallel.markdownDescription: In parallel mode, the most test projects that run at the same time. `0` chooses it from this machine: half its processor cores, at most 4. Whatever the value, there are never more runs than the free memory holds (1.5 GB each), and no further run starts while less than 1 GB is free. A machine without that room runs in sequence.

coverageTools.watch.enabled.description: Detect coverage reports written by runs made outside the extension (terminal, tasks, scripts).

coverageTools.watch.globs.description: Glob patterns, relative to each workspace folder, of the coverage reports to detect.

coverageTools.exclude.description: Glob patterns, relative to each workspace folder, of paths ignored during discovery and watching.

enumDescriptions: Run the inner projects; the outer project is not run.
Run the outer project only; it is expected to run the inner ones.
coverageTools.nestedProjects.description: When test projects of the same ecosystem are nested, run the inner ones (`inner`) or the outer one (`outer`).

coverageTools.dotnet.collector.description: Forces the value passed to `--collect` when running VSTest projects (for example `XPlat Code Coverage`). Empty: chosen from the project's packages.

coverageTools.dotnet.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for `dotnet test` (VSTest) or for the test application (Microsoft.Testing.Platform).

coverageTools.node.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the Node test command (Jest, Vitest, or the test script run under c8).

coverageTools.python.interpreter.description: Python interpreter used to run tests and convert `.coverage` files. Empty: the project's `.venv` or `venv`, then the interpreter selected in the Python extension, then `python3`.

coverageTools.python.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments for the Python test runner (pytest or unittest).

coverageTools.commands.markdownDescription: Your own coverage command per project: maps a project directory, relative to the workspace folder, to a command line run in that directory through the shell. `${coverageDir}` is replaced with a temporary directory where the command must write an Istanbul JSON, Cobertura or LCOV report. The directory becomes a project (full runs only) and replaces any project found inside it.

scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --project unit
